column1: # PRESET DEAD-VALUE FRONTIER — armed settings that are known no-ops, and armed
# settings whose delivered value is not their configured value.
# Columns:  yaml-file <TAB> dotted-key <TAB> value <TAB> count <TAB> class <TAB> note
# Classes:
#   dead-value          a legal value that disables the mechanism it appears to
#                       configure. The note must say what the mechanism does at
#                       this value, and what value would work.
#   capped-adjudicated  a DELIVERY_CAPPED key that IS armed, together with the
#                       measurement of what the lane actually received. Required
#                       before the arming is allowed to stand, because a
#                       measurement taken through an un-adjudicated capped key
#                       cannot be told apart from a null.
# A row here is a RECEIPT, not an endorsement. Additions and removals both fail
# the gate, so fixing one of these is a deliberate edit in the same commit.
# alpha_iteration: 1 — SIX shipped presets, ZERO optimizer steps
# `crates/ny-propagate/src/network/graph_alpha/bounds/warm_start.rs` runs
# `for iter in 0..config.iterations` and breaks on `iter == config.iterations - 1`
# BEFORE the SPSA gradient below it. At `iterations == 1` that fires at
# `iter == 0`, so the loop performs no gradient evaluation and no alpha update:
# every child in the tree is bounded with the parent's frozen alphas, re-masked.
# The value is delivered by `input_split/shared.rs::warm_start_alpha_config`,
# which overwrites `alpha_config.iterations` with
# `config.input_split_alpha_iteration` on every input-split warm-start child —
# see the `runtime-clear` row for that site in preset_override_frontier.tsv.
# This is NOT a general property of ny's alpha loops. The non-warm loops were
# fixed with the shared `alpha_crown_loop::alpha_iteration_needs_gradient`
# helper; `warm_start.rs` never adopted it. So `2` works and `1` does not, which
# is exactly the shape that survives review.
# `alpha_iteration: 0` is NOT listed: zero is honestly off (the `> 0` gates skip
# the path entirely), and linearizenn_2024 sets it deliberately. ONE is the only
# value that claims refinement and delivers none.
# The in-tree workaround `#cgan-polish` raises the count at runtime, and is
# armed by no shipped yaml.
